context.transcript:
Welcome to the Bransford Public Library's workshop on
digital photo editing. ®Today you'll learn how to use the
basic features of a well-known photo editing program. Before
we start, a few reminders. Please refrain from eating in
the classroom, and keep drinks away from the computers.
They were a generous donation, and we'd like to have the
computers for future classes. Also, don't forget there's a
special summer discount available if you'd like to purchase
a copy of the software for your home computer. You can find
more information on it by clicking the "Partners" link on the
library Website.
